covered.why: First decision that shapes everything downstream. Learner converts a vague business ask into a concrete ML task (classification/regression, target, success metric).
Python programmer's entry point. Pandas profiling, dtypes, missingness, distributions, correlations — the lens they'll use for every dataset.
Real data is messy. Imputation, encoding, scaling, outlier handling — the hands-on steps that make or break production models.
Highest ROI activity for tabular ML. Interactions, datetime decomposition, target encoding, embeddings for high-cardinality categoricals.
Non-negotiable for honest evaluation. Time-based vs random, stratification, leakage prevention — the guardrails against fooling yourself.
Reliable performance estimates with limited data. K-fold, stratified, grouped CV — when each applies and how to use sklearn's tools.
Must beat a baseline before complex modeling. Mean/median for regression, majority class for regression, simple rules — often surprisingly strong.
Interpretable, fast, production-ready. Regularization (L1/L2), probability calibration, feature importance via coefficients — often sufficient for production.
State-of-the-art for tabular data. XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost usage, key hyperparameters, handling categoricals, early stopping — production standard.
Match metrics to business problem. Precision/recall/F1, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, MAE/RMSE/RMSLE — and why accuracy is often the wrong choice.
Tree models need tuning. Optuna integration, search spaces, pruning, n_jobs — practical tuning in hours, not days.
Match metrics to business problem. Precision/recall/F1, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, MAE/RMSE/RMSLE — and why accuracy is often the wrong choice.
Bridge from notebook to production. joblib/pickle/MLflow model format, versioning, metadata (training data hash, metrics, params) — deployable artifact.
Architectural decision shaping deployment. Batch (scheduled, high-throughput) vs online (low-latency, request-response) — tradeoffs and when each fits.
Concrete production skill. FastAPI + Pydantic for validation, Dockerfile, health checks, graceful startup/shutdown — runnable container in hours.
Production reality — models degrade. Input distribution monitoring (PSI, KS test), prediction distribution shifts, performance proxy metrics — actionable alerts.

modules.title: Foundations: Problem Framing & Data Understanding
modules.capability: Convert a vague business problem into a concrete ML task definition (target, task type, success metric) and produce a data profile report covering distributions, missingness, correlations, and data quality issues
modules.why_here: The two concepts that must precede all others: defining what you're solving and understanding the raw material. Both are exploration-heavy, code-light, and set the frame for every downstream decision.

modules.title: Data Preparation: Cleaning, Preprocessing & Feature Engineering
modules.capability: Build a reusable preprocessing pipeline (imputation, encoding, scaling, datetime features, interaction features, target encoding) that fits on training data and transforms validation/test without leakage
modules.why_here: Both are hands-on data transformation steps that feed directly into modeling. They share the same pandas/sklearn toolchain and the same 'fit on train, transform on test' discipline. Splitting them would fragment the preprocessing pipeline.

modules.title: Modeling: Baselines, Linear Models & Tree-Based Models
modules.capability: Train, compare, and select among baseline, linear, and gradient-boosted tree models using proper train/validation/test splits and cross-validation, with a reproducible training script that outputs a serialized model artifact
modules.why_here: Complete modeling stack from validation strategy through baseline to production-grade models. All use sklearn/XGBoost/LightGBM APIs. The split strategy and CV are prerequisites for honest model comparison; baselines, linear, and tree models form the progression from simple to state-of-the-art for tabular data.

modules.title: Evaluation & Iteration: Metrics, Cross-Validation & Hyperparameter Tuning
modules.capability: Select and justify evaluation metrics aligned to the business problem, then run hyperparameter optimization (Optuna) targeting that metric to produce a tuned model with documented performance
modules.why_here: Metrics define what 'good' means; tuning finds the best configuration. Both are iteration-loop activities — you evaluate, tune, re-evaluate. They belong together because tuning optimizes for a specific metric, and metric choice changes tuning outcomes.

modules.title: Production: Serialization, Serving, API Deployment & Monitoring
modules.capability: Package a trained model as a versioned artifact, choose and justify a serving pattern (batch vs online), deploy an online inference API with FastAPI + Docker (health checks, input validation, logging), and implement basic data drift monitoring on input features and predictions
modules.why_here: End-to-end production path: artifact → serving pattern → API container → monitoring. Each step consumes the previous. Batch vs online is the architectural fork; the API module implements online; monitoring closes the loop. One coherent deployment narrative.

modules.title: Day 1 Morning: Problem Framing & Data Preparation
modules.capability: Convert a business problem into a concrete ML task definition and produce a clean, feature-rich training/validation/test split ready for modeling, with a reusable preprocessing pipeline that prevents leakage

modules.title: Day 1 Afternoon: Modeling & Evaluation
modules.capability: Train, evaluate, and tune a gradient-boosted tree model (XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost) against a proper baseline using business-aligned metrics, with a reproducible training script that outputs a serialized model artifact

modules.title: Day 2: Production Deployment & Monitoring
modules.capability: Package a trained model as a versioned artifact, choose and justify a serving pattern (batch vs online), deploy an online inference API with FastAPI + Docker (health checks, input validation, logging), and implement basic data drift monitoring on input features and predictions
modules.why_here: End-to-end production path: artifact -> serving choice -> API container -> monitoring. Each step consumes the previous. One coherent deployment narrative. ~3-4 hours.
